purpose: Curated VFX integration batch drawn ONLY from the 7 evidenced owned Fab VFX products. NO IMPORTS performed. To reach the requested 10-20 distinct SYSTEMS from 7 products, individual Niagara sub-systems within each product are enumerated (e.g. the 15 footstep systems, the multiple spark/fire/smoke variants).

evidence_authorities.owned_vfx_intelligence: Copperlight-Asset-Catalog/reports/VFX_CAPABILITY.md (exactly 7 documented VFX-related Fab records; these are the ONLY evidenced VFX assets - none invented).
evidence_authorities.gameplay_source: Soul/Data/settlement_blueprints.json, environment_asset_bindings.json, city_siege_blueprints.json, battlefield_recipes.json; Soul/Plugins/RBWeather/Content/Presentation/VFX (existing Niagara integration target).

design_rationale_favor_niagara: User directive and Soul AGENTS.md both favor lightweight presentation ('interactive space, non-interactive clutter'; use RB Optimization). All 7 owned products are Niagara/Blueprint systems - there are NO owned fluid-sim/VDB assets to be tempted by, and the existing RBWeather presentation layer is already Niagara (NS_RB_* systems). So 'favor lightweight Niagara over fluids/VDB' is satisfied natively: every recommendation is a CPU/GPU Niagara emitter or BP particle, cheap enough for a PC-first turn-based strategy map with many simultaneous settlements/units.
integration_target_convention: Soul already stores Niagara systems as NS_RB_* under Plugins/RBWeather/Content/Presentation/VFX. Codex should follow the same NS_ naming + a dedicated presentation folder; DO NOT modify the existing RBWeather folder. VFX present canonical outcomes only (AGENTS.md architecture rule).

confidence_scale.high: Product+sub-system explicitly documented in VFX_CAPABILITY.md evidence and a clean 1:1 match to the Soul event.
confidence_scale.medium: Documented product, but the specific sub-system is a reasonable repurpose rather than a labeled match.
confidence_scale.specialty_caveat: Documented but thematically off (modern/gun); only sub-effects repurposable.

priority_scale: P0 = immediate high-impact; P1 = strong follow-up; P2 = polish/optional.

batch_summary.note: 20 enumerated systems/sub-systems drawn from the 7 evidenced Fab products (all Niagara/BP), within the requested ~10-20 range. 'systems' array includes 2 entries carrying explicit gap/caution flags (wind-control reconciliation with RBWeather; spell-school VFX gap note in spell_school_vfx_coverage).

systems.intended_event: unit movement on dirt/earth terrain (battlefield_recipes dirt/plain landforms; campaign step dust)
systems.caveats: One of 15 documented footstep systems. Pair with audio SET/foley dirt steps (TomMusic Dirt Walk/Run ids 1500-1509). Surface-type driven by terrain material.

systems.intended_event: unit movement on mud/wet ground (viking harbour, river_woodland)
systems.caveats: Documented mud system. Audio mud footstep is a thin owned gap (1 clip) - VFX is stronger than SFX here.

systems.intended_event: unit movement on grassland (human.grassland_crossroads, nature.grassland_edge)
systems.caveats: Documented grass system. Audio grass footsteps use the Fantozzi Sand set as grass stand-in (gap report); VFX grass is a clean match.

systems.intended_event: unit movement on quarry/stone-path (dwarf.high_quarry, dwarf.mountain_pass)
systems.caveats: Documented gravel system. Audio gravel is thin (1 clip) - lean on VFX.

systems.intended_event: unit movement on snow (viking.snow_pass, dwarf.snow_basin, dark.corrupted_mountain)
systems.caveats: Documented snow puff. Composes well with RBWeather NS_RB_Snow/Blizzard already in the project (do not modify those).

systems.intended_event: unit movement through shallow water (viking.harbour_edge shore, nature.river_woodland crossing)
systems.caveats: Documented water splash. Pair with TomMusic Water Walk/Run (ids 1548-1557).

systems.intended_event: unit movement on arid ground (orc.badlands mesa, dark.ash_plain desert donor)
systems.caveats: Documented sand system; doubles for ash/dust kick on the badlands/ash maps.

systems.intended_event: unit movement in forest/leaf litter (nature.forest_clearing, viking.forest_track)
systems.caveats: Documented leaves system; directly satisfies the 'leaves/wind' VFX shortlist item at the footstep scale.

systems.intended_event: fallback footstep puff for any unmaterialized surface
systems.caveats: Documented generic-surface system; safety fallback so no unit is silent/puffless on unclassified terrain.

systems.intended_event: heavy/metal-shod or construct units on stone (dwarf constructs, armored elites)
systems.caveats: Documented sparks footstep variant; overlaps with the dedicated Sparks Embers product - prefer whichever reads better for heavy infantry.

systems.intended_event: generic spell/ability ground burst - repurpose for magic cast ground FX (ties audio MAG_* cues)
systems.caveats: The documented 'special ability effect' Niagara system. Lightweight stand-in for spell-school ground VFX before/alongside the fire product. Favor this over heavier sims per user directive.

systems.product: M5 VFX Vol2. Fire and Flames(Niagara)
systems.intended_event: forge/furnace fires + camp fires (human.forge, dwarf.great_forge, viking.smithy, orc war-camp fires, city_siege 'fires' dynamic_layer)
systems.caveats: Documented Niagara fire with small-to-large scale and BP props. Bind to audio SET_FORGE_FIRE_BED (id 1388) / SET_TAVERN_FIRE. UE5 Niagara (Soul is UE5.8) - compatible.

systems.product: M5 VFX Vol2. Fire and Flames(Niagara)
systems.intended_event: tavern/mage-guild/ritual lighting (human.tavern, human.witch_collegium, dark.ritual_spire torches)
systems.caveats: Documented candles sub-content. Bind to audio SET_MAGE_GUILD Torch Loop (id 1618). Small-scale, cheap.

systems.product: M5 VFX Vol2. Fire and Flames(Niagara)
systems.intended_event: magic.fire spell-school VFX (Fireball/Firespray cast + impact)
systems.caveats: Documented flames/explosions content repurposed as the fire-school spell VFX. Bind to audio MAG_FIRE_CAST (ids 1582-1588). Satisfies 'spell-school VFX' shortlist for the Fire school directly; other schools (frost/water/earth/air/dark) have NO owned dedicated spell VFX - see caveat system VFX_SPELL_SCHOOLS_GAP.

systems.intended_event: forge working sparks (human.forge, dwarf.great_forge/hammer_hall, viking.smithy) + campfire embers (war camps, tavern hearth)
systems.variation_note: Documented uses: blacksmithing, welding, campfires, grinding, braziers - treat forge-spark and campfire-ember as 2 presets.
systems.caveats: Documented UE5 spark/ember Niagara. Bind to audio SET_FORGE_ANVIL/SET_FORGE_FIRE_BED. The single best 'the settlement is alive' cheap win when stacked with the forge fire + anvil audio.

systems.intended_event: battle.block/parry metal-on-metal spark burst (pairs audio BAT_SWORD_BLOCK/PARRY)
systems.caveats: Documented 'electrical/bullet impact' spark use repurposed as melee clash sparks. Short, cheap, high-feedback for the hidden-hex tactical layer.

systems.intended_event: region/battlefield atmosphere (dark.ash_plain low fog, dark.corrupted_valley mist, nature.ancient_shrine fog card, dwarf.forge_approach/snow smoke)
systems.variation_note: ground fog and panoramic fog presets.
systems.caveats: Documented environmental fog (ground to panoramic). Directly fills the many 'fog/mist/smoke' dressing entries in battlefield_recipes.json and city_siege_blueprints dynamic_layers. Lightweight Niagara - exactly the favor-Niagara directive.

systems.intended_event: siege debris / structure-collapse dust (city_siege damage_strategy 'smoke/fire', objectives gatehouse/walls) - pairs audio BAT_SIEGE_IMPACT_DEBRIS
systems.caveats: Documented dust/smoke used as the siege-impact dust puff + lingering collapse smoke. Combine with VFX_SPARKS_IMPACT for stone strikes. Satisfies 'siege debris' VFX shortlist via smoke+dust (no owned debris-mesh VFX exists; smoke/dust sells the hit cheaply).

systems.intended_event: ambient leaves/wind on campaign + battlefields (nature.forest_clearing 'falling leaves', viking/forest tracks, general wind dressing)
systems.caveats: Documented 6 BP particles + wind control. Satisfies 'leaves/wind' shortlist at ambient scale. CAUTION: Soul AGENTS.md forbids a second authority for Weather - RBWeather owns weather/wind. Use this product ONLY for decorative leaf/particle motion driven by (not competing with) RBWeather, or defer. Flag for Codex to reconcile with RBWeather wind before adopting the control-system half.

systems.intended_event: UI polish - particle flourish on recruit/build-complete/selection panels (pairs audio UI_* cues)
systems.caveats: Integration PLUGIN, not a particle content pack - it lets Niagara render inside UMG. Enables cheap CPU sprite/ribbon flourishes in HUD. Optional polish; verify UE5.8 plugin compatibility before enabling. Do not block the audio batch on it.

excluded_products_note.decision: EXCLUDED from primary batch (LOW priority for a fantasy game). Caveat: its generic impact-spark and smoke-trail sub-effects could be repurposed if ever needed, but the dedicated Sparks Embers + Smoke & Fog products already cover those cases more cleanly. Do not use muzzle-flash/bullet content.

spell_school_vfx_coverage.frost_water_earth_air_dark: GAP: no owned dedicated Niagara for these schools. Interim: use VFX_SPECIAL_ABILITY_BURST (footstep product) tinted per school + VFX_SMOKE_FOG_ENV for dark/air. Only consider acquisition if elemental VFX becomes a headline feature; audio for these schools IS owned (TomMusic frost/water/earth), so the gap is visual-only. Flagged, not fabricated.
